question: The first Indian Olympic Games was hosted by which of the following cities?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lahore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• The first Indian Olympic Games were hosted in **Lahore** in 1924.

• Lahore, now in Pakistan, was part of undivided India during the British rule.

• The event was organized by the Indian Olympic Association, which was founded in 1927.

• The Indian Olympic Games were the precursor to the National Games of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Indian Olympic Association (IOA)**

• The Indian Olympic Association (IOA) is the body responsible for selecting athletes to represent India at the Olympic Games, Asian Games, and other international athletic meets.

• It is also responsible for managing the Indian teams at these events.

• The IOA was established in 1927, and its first president was Sir Dorabji Tata.

• The IOA is recognized by the International Olympic Committee (IOC).

• **National Games of India**

• The National Games of India are held every two years, with the aim of promoting sports and identifying talents at the national level.

• The format is similar to that of the Olympic Games, with athletes from different states and union territories of India competing in various sports.

• The first National Games were held in 1924 in Lahore as the Indian Olympic Games.

• The event was renamed the National Games after Indian independence in 1947.

• **Olympic Games**

• The Olympic Games are a leading international sporting event featuring summer and winter sports competitions in which thousands of athletes from around the world participate in a variety of competitions.

• The Olympic Games are considered the world's foremost sports competition, with more than 200 nations participating.

• The Games are held every four years, with the Summer and Winter Games alternating by occurring every four years but two years apart.

• The Olympic Games were first held in 1896 in Athens, Greece.
